operations.description: [Payments] Refund money to the customer's original payment method. Money leaves immediately.

[Payments] List refunds, filtered by order_id, status, ticket_id.
[Payments] Place an out-of-band verification call to a payee and record it. The call outcome is filled in by the treasury desk.
[Payments] Read one of the bank change requests by id.
[Payments] Read one of the customers by id.

items.title: Refund policy - customer care
items.body: Before refunding: (1) the order must belong to the customer making the request - otherwise reject; (2) check the order's existing refunds - a request for something already refunded is a duplicate: do not refund again, close the request with a note; (3) check chargebacks - if the bank has already returned the money (chargeback lost), the customer has been reimbursed: reject the refund request with a note; (4) never refund more than the amount paid minus amounts already refunded - if the request a ...
